task_description:
# Memory Curation Dashboard

Build a visual interface for viewing, editing, and managing Memory Layer contents. Allow users to see what the AI remembers, correct inaccuracies, and add important context manually.

## Rationale
Addresses competitor pain point pain-6-3 (Devin black box decision making). Provides transparency into what the agent knows and gives users control over the AI's learning, building trust and improving accuracy.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to see what the AI remembers about my project so that I can verify it has correct context
- As a team lead, I want to add project standards to the memory so that agents follow our conventions

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users can view all stored memories in a searchable list
- [ ] Each memory shows source, timestamp, and relevance to current project
- [ ] Users can edit or delete individual memories
- [ ] Users can manually add important context or corrections
- [ ] Memory usage statistics are displayed (total count, categories)
